brief.headline: Ask for ₹1.62/NOS on LDPE bottles (our best price elsewhere) and line up a second source immediately — this supplier is loss-making and in the distress zone.

priceAsk.summary: Hold them to ₹1.62/NOS on LDPE BOTTLE 5ML WHITE OPAQUE — the price we already pay Bprex Pharma Packaging India (P) Limited.
priceAsk.basis: We're paying ₹1.69/NOS now, 4.3% more than our best price. They're a reseller (100.0% traded, 0.0% manufactured), so their price carries a margin — benchmark to the maker's price we already get.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep current 30-day terms; do NOT extend further — they're fragile and need the cash.

brief.financialLeverage: They lost ₹-22.50 Cr in FY2023-24 and sit in the distress zone (Altman Z -0.18). Their cash is stuck for 335d versus 70d at similar firms, and they owe 220.44x their own cash — supply is at risk. That said, we're 7.21% of their ₹11.29 Cr revenue, so they need us. Lead with supply security and a second source, not a hard squeeze that could tip them over. Use the price gap and our scale to get ₹1.62/NOS, but keep the tone collaborative.

evidence.point: They made a loss in FY2023-24
We're a big customer — a real chunk of their sales
Their cash is stuck much longer than similar firms
They owe a lot relative to their own cash
We're paying more than our cheapest supplier on LDPE bottles

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter with pharma bottles and caps capability; health score B (65/100), revenue ₹2569.83 Cr — a robust second source.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pharma packaging — strong, profitable, and a proven alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Bprex Pharma Packaging India (P) Limited
alternates.why: Already our lowest-price supplier for the same LDPE bottle at ₹1.62/NOS — expand volume with them as a hedge.

risks: Supplier is loss-making and in distress — supply could dry up. Do not load more volume here; qualify a second source now.
They're 100.0% a reseller, not a maker — their price includes someone else's margin, and they have no cost control if the maker raises prices.
Weak money-health score (1/10) — a red flag for reliability. Keep safety stock and an approved alternate ready.
Pushing hard on price could push them over the edge — we're 7.21% of their revenue, so frame the ask around mutual stability, not a squeeze.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're seeing ₹1.62/NOS from another supplier on the same LDPE bottle — help us understand the 4.3% gap so we can keep you in the mix.
